videos.title: From The BIG EAST Vault: Villanova Defeats UConn In The 1983 BIG EAST Tournament
videos.description: BIG EAST Conference 'From the BIG EAST Vault' highlights of Villanova's 69-68 win over UConn in the 1983 Big East Tournament quarterfinals at Madison Square Garden.

videos.title: Providence vs  UConn in 10 Minutes (from 1982)
videos.description: Ten-minute condensed replay, posted by the Friarbasketball channel, of UConn's 47-45 overtime win at Providence; the Friars, led by Otis Thorpe and Ron Jackson, lost at the buzzer in overtime.

videos.title: UConn at #1 Georgetown 1985
videos.description: TV broadcast of UConn at No. 1 Georgetown at the Capital Centre, Patrick Ewing's senior season; Georgetown won 79-66.

videos.title: Earl Kelley Game Winner UConn vs. Syracuse 1985
videos.description: Earl Kelley's game-winning play in the final seconds of UConn's 71-69 win over Syracuse at the Hartford Civic Center (on-screen caption 'Feb. 20th 1985', score tied 69-69 on the TV graphic).

videos.title: Earl Kelley Mouths "Game Over" as He Drops Game Winner Against Syracuse
videos.description: Earl Kelley, in UConn's blue road uniform, sinks the clinching free throws and mouths 'game over' as UConn upsets nationally ranked Syracuse 70-68 at the Carrier Dome; Kelley scored six of his 21 points on free throws in the final 31 seconds.

videos.title: WTXX-TV UConn vs. St. John's Big East Basketball Promo (1986)
videos.description: 30-second WTXX-TV (Channel 20, Connecticut) promo, aired in February 1986, for its broadcast of the UConn vs. St. John's Big East game.

videos.title: Hartford Civic Center roof collapse (1978)
videos.description: History Channel 'Engineering Disasters' segment on the collapse of the Hartford Civic Center roof early on January 18, 1978, hours after UConn beat UMass 56-49 there before 4,746 fans.

videos.title: Big East Rewind Episode 176: Featuring Corny Thompson Connecticut Legend
videos.description: Big East Rewind podcast interview (2025) with Corny Thompson on his recruitment, choosing UConn and playing for Dom Perno (1978-82), Big East memories, the Dallas Mavericks and his pro career in Italy and Spain.

videos.title: Behind the Brand w/ Preston & EZ Bluez: UCONN Legend Earl Kelley
videos.description: New Haven Independent 'Behind the Brand' livestream interview (2020) with UConn guard Earl Kelley (1982-86), the New Haven native and Wilbur Cross High star.

videos.title: Big East Rewind Zoomcast Episode 134: Featuring Phil Gamble UConn Legend
videos.description: Big East Rewind podcast interview with Phil Gamble, who arrived at UConn as a freshman in Dom Perno's final season (1985-86) and played through 1988-89.
